title: Turn a title into a URL slug with a length limit
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It converts any input with str(), so slugify(None, 10) returns "none" instead of raising TypeError, and the note claiming the requester withdrew that rule is not part of the brief.
It extracts ASCII words, joins whole words that fit, cuts an over-long first word and raises TypeError and ValueError exactly as the brief requires.
When the first word is longer than max_length it returns an empty slug, so slugify("Supercalifragilistic", 5) returns "" instead of "super".
Building the full slug and cutting at the last hyphen within max_length + 1 keeps exactly the whole words that fit, and an over-long first word is cut to max_length.
